title: King Charles calls for reconciliation and unity in Christmas message
summary: Monarch urges people to draw strength from community diversity after a year marked by division and violence King Charles has called for reconciliation after a year of deepening division, saying in his Christmas address that people must find strength in the diversity of their communities to ensure right defeats wrong. The monarch cited the spirit of the second world war generation, which he said came together to take on the challenge that faced them; displaying qualities he said have shaped both the UK and the Commonwealth.
